about: Mini input bundle for the demo of eval.py (iteration 4, evaluation 3). 'results_files' are the small results/* files verbatim (raw text). 'tables' are <=100-row slices of the three row-level tables that eval.py turns into datasets (b_table.parquet held-out concepts, spec_curve_specs.csv, claims_ledger_v3.csv), plus the status column of the iteration-3 Eval2 ledger. 'reference_full_run' holds metrics_agg and dataset sizes from the original full run for comparison.
